summary: The Becket Athenaeum urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding and support for schools and libraries, emphasizing the critical role of the program in providing affordable connectivity for students and communities.

claims.argument: The Becket Athenaeum urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding and support for schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: I urge the FCC to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E-Rate Program. Though our library does not rely on E-Rate, it is critical funding for many schools and libraries in order to continue providing their communities with the ability to participate in our society.
